digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport retry layer
propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiting (8.6+, DC only, off by default) returns 429 responses that are currently not retried, causing hard failures on token bucket exhaustion
A 429 response with Retry-After header should be retried on opted-in idempotent read operations with jitter applied and delay clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S
Rate limit retry must be scoped to idempotent reads via per-call opt-in defaulting to OFF to prevent duplicate mutations when 429 arrives after server begins the write

The rate_limit_retry flag must reach the retry layer through two distinct paths: PATH A via _call_logged from _paged_search, and PATH B via direct _with_connection_retry calls like get_comment_map's per-issue fetch
Cap exhaustion must raise BackendHTTPError with code 429 and never leak JIRAError past the adapter boundary
Four specific read call sites must opt into rate limit retry: get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map's _paged_search call, get_comment_map's per-issue fetch, and get_parent_map
